changes.location: Security Signal Review › Detection and Operational Readiness
changes.before: Detection and operational readiness have limited configuration assurance. Microsoft 365 audit-log search receives full credit at 3/3, while the separate mailbox-auditing recommendation receives 0/3. These results remain distinct because audit-search availability does not establish complete mailbox logging, retention, monitoring, or investigation coverage. There needs to be a separate mailbox-auditing policy implemented to receive credit for that recommendation. Audit-search credit does not establish detection or response effectiveness. Mailbox auditing should be validated with the collaboration settings.
